overview: Chad is a large landlocked country in north-central Africa, named after Lake Chad. Its capital and largest city is N'Djamena. Chad became independent from France in 1960. Arabic and French are its official languages, and it is home to more than 100 ethnic groups.

geography.text: Northern Chad is part of the Sahara and contains the Tibesti Mountains, with their volcanic peaks. The centre is the dry Sahel, and the south is wetter savanna, where most people live. Lake Chad in the west has shrunk greatly since the 1960s.
